description: Shell script for testing the return value of 'diff' commands in Git. It sets up various repositories, performs multiple 'git diff' commands with different options, and checks their exit codes to verify diff behavior across files inside and outside repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting a successful (zero exit) status after executing a command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specified non-zero code.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a file or output.
